scope_note: Corrective residual modeled account for Microsoft San Antonio. Eight transferred construction, labor, procurement, operating, and household-output scenarios were removed because their arbitrary capital shares, forecast-realization cases, local-purchase assumptions, and Virginia coefficients were not bounded by project observations. Only three low-confidence descriptive county comparisons remain: each uses the project's documented operating-by 2013 anchor and official Bexar County outcome data, has a finite fit-sensitivity envelope, and explicitly makes no causal attribution. The account intentionally remains incomplete because no defensible direct observation or residual model closes the supplier category.

interval.interpretation: Central is the 2024 percentage gap; width is the larger of five percentage points or twice the 2005-2012 pre-period RMSE. It is a fit sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: A defensible causal design with treatment isolation, uncontaminated controls, placebo tests, spillover analysis, and robustness diagnostics

assumptions: Matching uses 2005-2012 log level, average log growth, and growth volatility.
Study counties are excluded from the donor pool.
The 2013 operating-by anchor is not assumed to be first county exposure or an isolated treatment date.

limitations: This comparison is descriptive and must not be interpreted as a data-center effect.
The donor screen excludes study counties but cannot exclude every unobserved data-center or concurrent economic treatment.
Bexar County contains multiple data centers and major overlapping investments.
The interval is a fit sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.
